name: comparison_loss
description: Comparison loss in microwave power meter calibration. Simplified model with zero voltage reflection coefficients for standard and generator ports. Model: delta_Y = X1^2 + X2^2, where X1 and X2 are real and imaginary components of the mismatch reflection coefficient.
